result.instructions: Call connect for resident firmware or deploy for the RAM bridge explicitly; one board session persists across tools. Source uses printable ASCII lines <=235 bytes. After timeout, use console_input for KEY and await_result; no new source is queued.

tools.name: connect
tools.description: Attach to the already-running resident VIOS firmware without RAM deployment (resident backend).

tools.name: reboot
tools.description: Restart resident firmware and reconnect on the same serial port. force=true explicitly abandons pending/unknown execution and loses unsaved RAM state.

tools.name: module_stage
tools.description: Validate and stage exact ASCII module source and pinned dependencies; does not activate.

tools.name: module_activate
tools.description: Activate one staged module after validation.

tools.name: module_discard
tools.description: Discard the staged module without activation.

tools.name: module_rollback
tools.description: Restore a retained previous module generation.

tools.name: modules
tools.description: List module versions, decimal CRC32 values and pinned dependencies.

tools.name: module_source
tools.description: Read exact retained module source plus host-computed source SHA-256.

tools.name: module_save
tools.description: Save a module package; defaults to its verified content-addressed path.

tools.name: module_load
tools.description: Load a saved module package and stage/activate it.

tools.name: load
tools.description: Evaluate a raw Forth source file from SD.

tools.name: boot_status
tools.description: Inspect confirmed/candidate/current boot slots and trial state.

tools.name: boot_trial
tools.description: Write an inactive boot bundle containing all active modules and mark it pending; does not reboot.

tools.name: boot_confirm
tools.description: Confirm the currently running trial after validation.

tools.name: boot_revert
tools.description: Select the confirmed/previous boot slot; does not reboot.

tools.name: deploy
tools.description: Explicitly replace/readback-verify CPU RAM; RAM backend also loads temporary ESP bridge.

tools.name: evaluate
tools.description: Evaluate bounded ASCII Forth lines, preserving definitions/stacks and multiline compilation.

tools.name: await_result
tools.description: Wait for a timed-out evaluation to complete without queuing source or nonce input.

tools.name: console_input
tools.description: Send 1..16 explicit bytes to a pending evaluation, for example a Forth KEY.

tools.name: words
tools.description: List the resident dictionary.

tools.name: inspect_word
tools.description: Read SEE source and word/address metadata.

tools.name: stacks
tools.description: Inspect the data stack using .S.

tools.name: resources
tools.description: Inspect dictionary and observed VM resources.

tools.name: benchmark
tools.description: Run validated hardware benchmarks; may take up to 120 seconds.

tools.name: abort
tools.description: Cancel input/current definition at the idle REPL. Pending KEY/wedges require console input, explicit resident reboot(force=true), or debug/redeploy.

tools.name: debug_registers
tools.description: Briefly debug-pause to read CPU registers, preserving prior pause state.

tools.name: memory_read
tools.description: Read 1..65536 RAM bytes from 0x40000..0xBFFFF with debug CRC checking.

tools.name: memory_write
tools.description: Write and readback-verify 1..256 RAM bytes below 0xAF000. Trusted systems operation.

tools.name: resume
tools.description: Resume existing CPU PC/UART bridge after a debug pause; does not reboot.

tools.name: wb_status
tools.description: Inspect the native workbench draft revision and state.

tools.name: wb_open
tools.description: Open the text workbench, retaining any existing draft.

tools.name: wb_close
tools.description: Close the text workbench and retain its draft.

tools.name: wb_browse
tools.description: Browse modules or words, optionally filtering words by module.

tools.name: wb_select
tools.description: Select a module name or absolute word catalog index.

tools.name: wb_edit
tools.description: Load exact active module source; dirty replacement requires explicit discard.

tools.name: wb_new
tools.description: Create one module draft; dirty replacement requires explicit discard.

tools.name: wb_patch
tools.description: Apply one atomic revision-checked source patch of at most 80 ASCII bytes.

tools.name: wb_undo
tools.description: Restore the one source/cursor undo snapshot.

tools.name: wb_metadata
tools.description: Set draft version and optional test word, retaining pinned dependencies.

tools.name: wb_stage
tools.description: Validate and test the exact draft without activation.

tools.name: wb_activate
tools.description: Activate the staged draft after revision and catalog validation.

tools.name: wb_save
tools.description: Persist only the exact currently active draft.

tools.name: wb_source
tools.description: Read exact draft ASCII in bounded chunks with revision validation.

tools.name: wb_view
tools.description: Read desired 80-column screen rows with text and packed attributes.

tools.name: wb_key
tools.description: Inject a semantic workbench key (ASCII or 256..267) and modifier bits.

tools.name: wb_redraw
tools.description: Invalidate and recompose the desired text screen.

tools.name: wb_flush
tools.description: Drain changed spans in bounded batches and return flush counters.

tools.name: wb_render_stats
tools.description: Read cumulative renderer counts and target 288 kHz ticks.
